foundation.typed_empty_class: An empty class is tagged by logical type; distinct types may have equal cardinality zero without being the same typed object.
foundation.cardinality_zero: Zero is the cardinality assigned to an empty finite class, not the class object itself.
foundation.unit_class: A singleton has cardinality one; two tagged singleton occurrences have disjoint-union cardinality two.
foundation.word_11: The word '11' preserves two ordered occurrences of symbol '1'; it is not identical to arithmetic 2 or decimal 11 as a typed object.

exact_claims.statement: 77/33 and 7/3 are the same rational value.
The greatest common divisor of 77 and 33 is 11.
Reduction preserves rational value but discards the common-scale provenance unless it is recorded separately.
The word '11' has length two and multiplicity two for symbol '1'.

physical_bridge.question: Does presentation scale 11 induce a dimensionally defined, independently measurable RLL observable distinct from the reduced baseline?
known: The current RLL background implementation is parameterized by Omega_s0, z_t and w_t.
The factor 11 is recoverable as provenance of 77/33.
unknowns: No typed morphism from the word or presentation scale 11 to an RLL parameter has been derived.
No physical unit has been assigned to the proposed bridge.
No non-zero predicted observable delta with uncertainty has been registered.
No independent dataset or implementation has tested such a delta.
prohibited_claims: Omega_s0 equals zero because fractions reduce.
The factor 11 is physically irreducible without an observable.
Whitehead and Russell imply the RLL cosmology.
physical_bridge.next_gate: Define O_11 with a typed domain, codomain, units, null baseline, uncertainty model, falsifier, dataset, independent implementation and artifact hash.

exit_conditions.evidence_required: Typed morphism from discrete representation to RLL parameter space
exit_conditions.acceptance_criterion: Domain, codomain, totality/partiality and invariance assumptions are explicit and machine-readable.
Every mapped quantity has units or is explicitly dimensionless; equations pass a dimensional consistency review.
A preregistered function Delta O_11(z) differs from the null baseline on a stated domain.
A quantitative outcome that rejects or bounds the factor-11 coupling is declared before fitting.
Dataset provenance, covariance, masks and likelihood are committed with checksums.
A second implementation reproduces the prediction and inference within declared tolerance.
The run emits parameters, residuals, diagnostics, environment metadata and SHA-256 checksums.
